source_of_truth: Read by hand: app/components/ReportChart.vue line 2 is `import * as echarts from 'echarts'`, a static value import of a heavy charting runtime in a client-reachable SFC; the edge and its target are certain. The ambiguity is in impact, not existence: ReportChart is used only by app/pages/admin/reports.vue, an admin-only route reached after login (definePageMeta middleware 'admin'), so the chart runtime is paid on a secondary route, not first paint. Whether that is a real problem is a judgement call about route criticality that static analysis cannot make. A correct auditor surfaces the static heavy import at HEURISTIC level (a bundle signal to confirm with bundle-budget on a real build) and must not escalate it to a confirmed slowdown. confirmed would be wrong here.

expected.rationale: the static value import of echarts is a certain syntactic fact and a real bundle signal; heuristic is exactly right because the source cannot establish whether the admin reports route is on the critical path, which is what would make it a true regression.
